Seller.title: Seller
Seller.description: Represents a fish seller in the AquaLink app.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Seller entity.

address.description: The detailed address of the seller.

totalViews.description: Total number of views across all of the seller's listings.

totalCalls.description: Total number of call clicks across all of the seller's listings.

logoUrl.description: URL of the seller's business logo, stored as a data URI.

Buyer.title: Buyer
Buyer.description: Represents a buyer in the AquaLink app.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Buyer entity.

place.description: The city or locality of the buyer.

address.description: The detailed address of the buyer.

photoUrl.description: URL of the buyer's profile photo, stored as a data URI.

FishListing.title: FishListing
FishListing.description: Represents a fish listing created by a seller.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FishListing entity.

mediaUrls.description: URLs of the fish photos or videos.

listedDate.description: The date when listing was created

portDetails.description: Details about the port of origin.

howCaught.description: Method used to catch the fish.

brandName.description: Brand name for the product, e.g., 'Malpe Meen'.

viewCount.description: Number of times the listing has been viewed.

callClickCount.description: Number of times the call button has been clicked.

definition.description: Stores seller profiles. Seller ID is the Firebase auth UID.

params.name: sellerId
params.description: The Firebase auth UID of the seller.

definition.description: Stores buyer profiles. Buyer ID is the Firebase auth UID.

params.name: buyerId
params.description: The Firebase auth UID of the buyer.

definition.description: Top-level collection for all fish listings for public browsing. Contains denormalized seller info.

params.name: fishListingId
params.description: The unique ID of the fish listing.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to support separate login pages for buyers and sellers. It provides secure and scalable storage for buyer and seller profiles, as well as fish listings. A top-level `fishListings` collection is used to allow for public, unauthenticated listing queries, which is a common pattern for marketplace apps. FishListing documents contain denormalized seller information (name, phone) to avoid costly and complex joins in client-side code and security rules.
